verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing page references Rovo AI-driven 'custom automations' with reminders and rules that move work forward, plus customizable workflows, aligning with trigger-and-action automation. However, there's no detailed documentation of the actual rule builder (triggers/conditions/actions) or independent community validation specifically about automation rules. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the trigger/condition/action rule builder, independent/hands-on evidence confirming automation rules work as advertised.
